crossRefs.note: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn…
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk…
For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your…
But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
“Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
“Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
“I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the lawyer of this world? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this…
constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain.…
You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay; that the thing made should say about him who…
Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions…

translations.web: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
translations.bsb: But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”
translations.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
translations.asv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why didst thou make me thus?
